findings.what: The signature still does not cover liveness decision fields such as ok and fallback, so signed failure/fallback records can be edited into passing records without invalidating attest_sig.
findings.why: verifyRecord HMACs only SIGNED_FIELDS. I reproduced a signed ok:false record, flipped ok to true, and gauntlet-verify with requireSignature:true returned ok:true/status ran. I also reproduced a signed fallback:true record flipped to fallback:false that cert-attest accepted as an attested contracted lane. This leaves the forged-liveness mistake class open without reading the secret.

findings.what: The security panel floor corroboration path reads ledger records without requiring attest_sig at all.
findings.why: applyPanelGate matches same-run records by role/provider/shape/tool_id/output_digest/cmdline_checksum, but never calls verifyRecord. I reproduced unsigned hand-authored openai+claude ok:true records making floor_pass true. Even if gauntlet-verify is fixed, this binding panel reader can still be fooled by forged unsigned liveness records.

findings.what: Legacy signature fallback accepts records that contain verdict, keeping verdict mutable for legacy-signed records.
findings.why: verifyRecord tries LEGACY_SIGNED_FIELDS unconditionally. I reproduced a legacy-signed verdict:fail record, flipped verdict to pass, and verifyRecord still returned true. That preserves the exact FAIL-to-PASS verdict flip for legacy-signed review records; backcompat needs a version/field-set discriminator or must only accept legacy signatures where verdict is absent/non-decision-bearing.

parsed.summary: Fail. The round-1 fail-closed binding fixes are mostly closed, but ED-231 signing is still partial: current signatures omit fields the gates actually trust, one panel reader omits signature verification entirely, and legacy backcompat keeps verdict mutable for old signed records.
